caseNameFull: Chandler v. United States Hicks v. Texas Johnson v. Illinois Colvin-El v. Maryland Valdes v. Florida Milke v. Arizona Mordenti v. Florida

opinions.text: C. A. 11th Cir.; Ct. Crim. App. Tex.; Sup. Ct. Ill.; Ct. App. Md.; Sup. Ct. Fla.; Sup. Ct. Ariz.; and Sup. Ct. Fla. Certiorari denied.

opinions.author: Blackmun
opinions.text:
Justice Blackmun,

dissenting.

Adhering to my view that the death penalty cannot be imposed fairly within the constraints of our Constitution, see my dissent in Callins v. Collins, 510 U. S. 1141, 1143 (1994), I would grant certiorari and vacate the death sentences in these cases.
